description: This file implements API routes for note sharing and collaboration features in a note-taking application. It includes endpoints to share notes with other users, retrieve shared notes, manage sharing permissions, revoke access, and toggle public visibility of notes.

methods.name: share_note( note_id: int, share_request: ShareNoteRequest, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Shares a note with another user by creating or updating a SharedNote record.

methods.name: get_shared_notes( current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves all notes shared with the current user.

methods.name: get_note_shares( note_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of users the specified note is shared with; accessible only by the note owner.

methods.name: revoke_note_share( note_id: int, user_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Revokes sharing access from a specific user for a given note.

methods.name: toggle_public_sharing( note_id: int, make_public: bool, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Toggles the public visibility status of a note.

ctags.pattern: /^from app.schemas import ShareNoteRequest, SharedNote as SharedNoteSchema, Note as NoteSchema$/
